questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental SI unit?
questions.explanation: Ampere (A) is one of the seven basic fundamental SI units used to measure electric current. Newton, Joule, and Watt are derived units.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Units and Measurements

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: When a particle is thrown vertically upwards, what is its velocity at the highest point?
questions.explanation: At the peak of its trajectory, a vertically thrown object momentarily comes to rest before descending, making its instantaneous velocity equal to 0 m/s.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Straight Line

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: What is the molar mass of water (H₂O)?
questions.explanation: Molar mass of H₂O = 2(Atomic mass of H) + 1(Atomic mass of O) = 2(1.008) + 16.00 ≈ 18 g/mol.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which subatomic particle was discovered by J.J. Thomson?
questions.explanation: J.J. Thomson discovered the electron in 1897 through his cathode ray tube experiments.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce cellular energy in the form of ATP via aerobic respiration, hence called the powerhouses of the cell.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In Five Kingdom Classification, who proposed the system?
questions.explanation: R.H. Whittaker (1969) proposed the Five Kingdom Classification: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, and Animalia.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which phylum consists of organisms with a water vascular system?
questions.explanation: The water vascular system is a distinctive feature of echinoderms, helping in locomotion, capture and transport of food, and respiration.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which type of tissue connects bone to muscle?
questions.explanation: Tendons are dense regular connective tissues that attach skeletal muscles to bones. Ligaments connect bone to bone.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 7: Structural Organisation in Animals

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: What is the angle of projection for maximum horizontal range in projectile motion?
questions.explanation: Horizontal range R = (u² sin 2θ) / g. Range is maximum when sin 2θ = 1, which implies 2θ = 90°, so θ = 45°.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 4: Motion in a Plane

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: Which of the following elements has the highest electronegativity?
questions.explanation: Fluorine (F) is the most electronegative element in the periodic table, with a value of 4.0 on the Pauling scale.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements
